title: The Jar of Almost-Names
content: Lexor arrives at the cabin carrying a jar that remembers the sound of names almost spoken and withdrawn. He leaves it on the mantel between the crow and Privathor's brass key, then departs by choice. The following morning and day, the household keeps the jar without forcing an explanation; Privathor remains, Brograntimax makes room, and Herbarius calls the object a held breath. Its purpose and the withdrawn name remain unresolved.
continuity: The two scenes are preserved in chronological order. Lexor leaves the jar and departs freely; Privathor remains through the following day. The jar's purpose, the name Lexor tried to withdraw, and any effect beyond the recorded slow movement of the pebble remain unknown.
